goal: Allow local RPC callers and bitcoin-cli to connect over UNIX domain sockets instead of TCP loopback
Let node operators rely on filesystem permissions for RPC access control instead of IP filtering
agreement: Concept approval citing demand from downstream projects relying on Core (winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: a second node overwrites an active socket path without error (b-l-u-e)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fulfills a long-standing feature request for local RPC over UNIX sockets
Local RPC callers avoid TCP loopback overhead
Operators can manage local access using standard filesystem permissions instead of IP checks
